_provenance: Hand-constructed to match the AWS Bedrock Runtime `Converse` API response shape documented at https://docs.aws.amazon.com/bedrock/latest/APIReference/API_runtime_Converse.html (`output.message.content[].toolUse`, `stopReason`, `usage.{inputTokens,outputTokens,totalTokens}`), fed as-is (minus this key) to `bedrock.parse_reply()` in src/fleet/llm/backends/bedrock.py — the same Mapping shape that module's own `converse_body()` test helper builds. Rung: TOOL_CALL, matching `build_request()`'s `toolConfig` branch. Envelope shape is identical to the REPO_CLASSIFY fixture in this same directory (`bedrock_tool_call.json`) by design: `_TOOL_NAME = "emit_response"` (src/fleet/llm/backends/bedrock.py:71) is a role-agnostic constant and `parse_reply` never introspects `toolUse.input`'s internal shape, so only the `input` payload below (a `DependencyDisambiguation`-schema object) differs. `chosen_coordinate` uses the `ecosystem:group:name` key format `Coordinate.key` computes (src/fleet/models/repo.py:34, ADR-0017); npm has no group here, so the group segment is empty (`npm::left-pad`).
